intro: Raising Spirits is a Horde quest in the Arathi Highlands where Tor'gan seeks to lift the spirits of a despondent orc named Gor'mul. When tales of Orgrimmar and Warchief Thrall fail, Tor'gan turns to newly rediscovered shamanic traditions to craft a revitalizing amulet from highland raptor eyes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We tried to settle him in, cheer him up, telling him stories of our mighty city at Orgrimmar in Kalimdor, but nothing would move him.

Tales of our young Warchief, Thrall, who bears the armor and hammer of Orgrim... But, perhaps... Perhaps! A demonstration of our newly found shamanistic magic would give him new hope. It is worth a try!
A small object we could make for him, yes... Bring me some raptor eyes, and I will see what I can do.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I will create an amulet that will give Gor'mul some of the strength of the raptors. Perhaps that will awaken some flame within him...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent. The spirits of the raptors that gave these eyes will lend strength to the bearer of this amulet.
